highlights: Green Lion G-Sport Smart Watch is an Android and IOS compatible watch which is equipped with a 1.28" screen combined by resolution of 240*240 dpi.

This combination ensures a clear and detailed visual experience with Thin-Film Transistor (TFT) technology and Wrist-up light, allowing users to view information, images, and text with sharpness and accuracy with vibrant colors and wide viewing angles of the TFT display.

Despite the high resolution, the smartwatch manages to maintain a reasonable battery capacity (230 mAh) with satisfying life for up to 7 days, making it a brilliant choice for users to whom both functionality and visual quality matters.
With Green Lion G-sport Smart Watch you have the ability to remotely control your smartphone camera, manage calls, reply massages and set alarm.

These significant features alongside with possibility of measuring blood oxygen and pressure level, sleep monitoring and activity tracking like calculating burnt calories and walked steps make this smart watch a perfect choice for every individual to whom being always active and informed is important.
This product comes in black, white, beige and orange and is reasonable in price.
